seoTitle: Plan Your Visit — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Plan your visit to Manchester River Cruises — getting here, accessibility, FAQs, gift vouchers and what to bring for your cruise from Salford Quays.
heading: Plan Your Visit
intro: Everything you need to plan a great day — or night — on the water.

sections.heading: What to bring
body: Dress for the weather and the water. Bring layers — it can be cooler on the open deck, even on a warm day — along with a waterproof just in case, and a camera for the skyline.
sections.note: There's a heated indoor cabin onboard if the weather turns.
